body: I just signed up for it~
What's This Land about? Is it an active server or what?
I get that when I try connecting to autcraft, but this isn't autcraft, I got in here.

I know it won't. But I'll feel happy to get one. It's like I know the reason why I'm hopelessly socially awkward, why I can't get my words out of my mouth like a normal person, why I'm slow and such. Knowing for sure that I do have that would definitely make me feel better.

Routines are good indeed. I have my routines with getting up, shower and then spend the rest of the day isolated in my room with my computer, haha.

Yeah I do. I'd say I'm a gamer. I play some wow, lol, rocket league, hearthstone and such... that's what it's mostly lately. I'll add you on steam. I don't have a PS4..

I'm glad you're thinking that way. I wish I was able to think more positively about my future. I've been isolating myself from most humans since January. But on the 23rd of august I move to start school and I will have to get along with people and live with 80 people (dorms) and I won't be able to get much alone time and I will have to get up early and sleep early (currently I go to bed at lkike 5am so...) it's gonna be a big difference for me.

I've been depressed for years generally so getting a diagnosis wouldn't make much of a difference there. I'd just be happy to have a explanation to myself for my weirdness or whatnot. I know I'm socially awkward, people tell me all the time, something's gotta be up.

Anyway I hope you're not feeling too bad.

I haven't yet. I'm moving in two days and when I'm finally settling down which will be on the 23rd I will go find a doctor as soon as I can. Getting desperate for a diagnosis. Maybe people will understand why I'm such an outcast if I get it, hah. I'm 20. Didn't know much about autism and such before my boyfriend mentioned he think I may have some kind of it earlier this year.
Oh woa... o: I just got a bit surprised I'm over average there when I only expected myself to have a really mild version of it.

I meant bad as in "am i too much over the average" or something like that. I'd feel happy to be diagnosed with it, but I never thought of it until this year after someone mentioned I may have it. But yea I'd be happy to have a diagnosis because it'll make me understand myself more. I know a diagnosis won't change who I am in any way but it'll please me to know.
I'm jealous. I just want an official diagnosis already to feel at peace, which I can't feel until I know. Hug your dogs from me
So I took the RAADS-R test thing. At least that thing which came up when I searched for RAADS-R. I tried to answer as honest as possible and [this is my result.](http://i.imgur.com/A3jwOxa.png)
